arguments.value: Lot of 7 portable generators in repairable condition, including diesel and gas-powered units. Models include Predator 9000 and Predator 4375 generators, plus military-style diesel units with protective housings and meter-equipped control panels. Working condition is unknown and repairs may be needed. Great opportunity for buyers seeking parts, repair, or restoration projects.
